Linked to eating/digestion.en: The throat feels as if it is choking specifically when eating bread.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: रोटी खाते समय गले में घुटन होती है
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Roti khate samay gale mein ghutan hoti hai

Linked to eating/digestion.en: The throat feels as if it is choking while in the act of eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते वक्त गले में घुटन होती है
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate wakt gale mein ghutan hoti hai

Triggered by specific situations.path: Throat, choking, drinking, when, if looked at
Triggered by specific situations.en: The throat feels as if it is choking when drinking, but only if someone is watching.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: पानी पीते समय अगर कोई देख रहा हो तो गले में घुटन होती है
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Pani pite samay agar koi dekh raha ho to gale mein ghutan hoti hai

Triggered by specific situations.path: Throat, choking, water, sight or thought of
Triggered by specific situations.en: The mere sight or thought of water brings on a choking feeling in the throat.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: पानी को देखने या उसके बारे में सोचने मात्र से गले में घुटन होती है
Triggered by specific situations.roman: pani ko dekhne ya uske bare mein sochne matr se gale mein ghutan hoti hai

Linked to a specific organ.en: There is a choking or tightening sensation felt in the food pipe (esophagus).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: भोजन नली में घुटन महसूस होती है
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Bhojan nali mein ghutan mehsus hoti hai

Linked to a specific organ.en: There is a choking sensation in the food pipe (esophagus) that seems to move from below upward.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: भोजन नली में नीचे से ऊपर की तरफ घुटन जैसी तकलीफ होती है
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Bhojan nali mein neeche se upar ki taraf ghutan jaisi takleef hoti hai

Comes with other symptoms.en: The choking feeling in the throat comes along with a headache.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: सिरदर्द के साथ गले में घुटन होती है
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Sirdard ke saath gale mein ghutan hoti hai

Comes with other symptoms.en: The choking feeling in the throat is triggered by or comes on with heart palpitations.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: दिल की धड़कन बढ़ने पर गले में घुटन होती है
Comes with other symptoms.roman: dil ki dhadkan badhne par gale mein ghutan hoti hai

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: The choking or constricted feeling in the throat comes on before the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी आने से पहले गले में घुटन होती है
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari aane se pehle gale mein ghutan hoti hai

Specific body area.path: Throat, choking, os hyoids, region of
Specific body area.en: There is a choking sensation in the area of the hyoid bone (the small bone at the base of the tongue, just above the voice box).
Specific body area.hi: गले की हड्डी (हाइऑइड) के आसपास घुटन जैसी तकलीफ होती है
Specific body area.roman: Gale ki haddi (hyoid) ke aaspas ghutan jaisi takleef hoti hai

Skin/tissue changes.en: The tonsils have a coated or covered appearance.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: टॉन्सिल पर सफेद परत चढ़ी हुई है
Skin/tissue changes.roman: tonsil par safed parat chadhi hui hai

Temperature sensation.en: There is a sensation of coldness in the throat.
Temperature sensation.hi: गले में ठंड लगने का अहसास होता है
Temperature sensation.roman: Gale mein thand lagne ka ahsaas hota hai

Temperature sensation.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, chilliness beginning in throat
Temperature sensation.en: A feeling of chilliness seems to begin or start in the throat.
Temperature sensation.hi: गले से ठंड शुरू होकर पूरे शरीर में फैलने लगती है
Temperature sensation.roman: Gale se thand shuru hokar pure sharir mein failne lagti hai

Temperature sensation.en: The throat feels as if something cold is touching it.
Temperature sensation.hi: गले में ठंडा-ठंडा महसूस होता है
Temperature sensation.roman: Gale mein thanda-thanda mehsus hota hai

Temperature sensation.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, cold air, as from
Temperature sensation.en: The throat feels as if cold air is blowing through it.
Temperature sensation.hi: गले में ऐसा लगता है जैसे ठंडी हवा आ रही हो
Temperature sensation.roman: Gale mein aisa lagta hai jaise thandi hawa aa rahi ho

Temperature sensation.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, cold, water were dropping down, as if
Temperature sensation.en: The throat feels as if drops of cold water are dripping down it.
Temperature sensation.hi: गले में ऐसा लगता है जैसे ठंडा पानी की बूँदें टपक रही हों
Temperature sensation.roman: Gale mein aisa lagta hai jaise thanda pani ki bunden tapak rahi hon

Temperature sensation.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, cold, wind, in
Temperature sensation.en: The throat feels as if cold wind is blowing through it.
Temperature sensation.hi: ठंडी हवा में गले में ठंड का अहसास होता है
Temperature sensation.roman: Thandi hawa mein gale mein thand ka ahsaas hota hai

Temperature sensation.hi: भोजन नली में ठंडक महसूस होती है
Temperature sensation.roman: Bhojan nali mein thandak mehsus hoti hai

Temperature sensation.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, esophagus, icy
Temperature sensation.en: The food pipe (esophagus) feels intensely icy cold.
Temperature sensation.hi: भोजन नली में बर्फ जैसी ठंडक महसूस होती है
Temperature sensation.roman: Bhojan nali mein barf jaisi thandak mehsus hoti hai

Temperature sensation.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, icy coldness
Temperature sensation.en: There is an intensely icy cold sensation in the throat.
Temperature sensation.hi: गले में बर्फ जैसी कड़ाके की ठंडक महसूस होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Gale mein barf jaisi kadhake ki thandak mehsus hoti hai

Temperature sensation.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, left, sensation of cold wind
Temperature sensation.en: The left side of the throat feels as if a cold wind is blowing through it.
Temperature sensation.hi: गले के बाईं तरफ ठंडी हवा लगने जैसी ठंडक महसूस होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Gale ke bain taraf thandi hawa lagne jaisi thandak mehsus hoti hai

Temperature sensation.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, peppermint, as from
Temperature sensation.en: The throat feels as if it has been touched by peppermint, giving a cold, tingly sensation.
Temperature sensation.hi: गले में पुदीने जैसी ठंडक महसूस होती है।
Temperature sensation.roman: Gale mein pudine jaisi thandak mehsus hoti hai

Linked to time of day.en: There is a sensation of coldness in the throat that comes on in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय गले में ठंडक महसूस होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ke samay gale mein thandak mehsus hoti hai

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, exhalation, on
Triggered by specific actions.en: The throat feels cold or cool when breathing out.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: सांस छोड़ते समय गले में ठंडक महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sans chhudte samay gale mein thandak mehsus hoti hai

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, inhalation, on
Triggered by specific actions.en: The throat feels cold or cool when breathing in.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: सांस अंदर लेते समय गले में ठंडक महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sans andar lete samay gale mein thandak mehsus hoti hai

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, swallowing, on
Triggered by specific actions.en: The throat feels cold when swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कुछ निगलते समय गले में ठंडक महसूस होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kuch niglte samay gale mein thandak mehsus hoti hai

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Throat, coldness, sensation of, warm drinks seem cold
Linked to eating/digestion.en: Warm drinks feel cold in the throat when swallowed.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: गरम पेय पीने पर भी गले में ठंडा लगता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Garam pey pine par bhi gale mein thanda lagta hai

Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a cramp or spasm in the food pipe (esophagus) when swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कुछ निगलते समय खाने की नली में ऐंठन होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kuch niglte samay khane ki nali mein aitan hoti hai

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, cramp, on swallowing food, compelling him to retch
Triggered by specific actions.en: When swallowing food, the throat cramps or spasms in a way that makes the person gag or retch.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाना निगलते समय गले में ऐसी ऐंठन होती है कि उबकाई आने लगती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khana niglte samay gale mein aisi aitan hoti hai ki ubkai aane lagti hai

Comes with other symptoms.en: The crawling sensation in the throat triggers a cough.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: गले में रेंगने जैसी अनुभूति होती है जिससे खांसी आ जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Gale mein rengne jaisi anubhuti hoti hai jisse khansi aa jati hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: The crawling or creeping sensation in the throat comes on during nausea.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: जी मिचलाने के दौरान गले में कुछ रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Ji michlane ke dauran gale mein kuch rengne jaisa mehsoos hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, crawling, esophagus, in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a crawling or creeping sensation inside the food pipe (esophagus).
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: खाने की नली में कुछ रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Khane ki nali mein kuch rengne jaisa mehsoos hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, crawling, worm, as if, were squirming in
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation in the throat as if a worm is wriggling or squirming around inside it.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में ऐसा लगता है जैसे कोई कीड़ा रेंग रहा हो।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein aisa lagta hai jaise koi kida reng raha ho.

Linked to time of day.en: The crawling or creeping sensation in the throat comes on in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय गले में कुछ रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ke samay gale mein kuch rengne jaisa mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The crawling or creeping sensation in the throat comes on in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय गले में कुछ रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay gale mein kuch rengne jaisa mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The crawling or creeping sensation in the throat comes on in the morning while still in bed.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह बिस्तर पर लेटे-लेटे गले में कुछ रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah bistar par lete-lete gale mein kuch rengne jaisa mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: The crawling or creeping sensation in the throat comes on during the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान गले में कुछ रेंगने जैसा महसूस होता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran gale mein kuch rengne jaisa mehsoos hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The crawling or creeping sensation in the throat comes on when swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: कुछ निगलते समय गले में रेंगने जैसी अनुभूति होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Kuch nigalte samay gale mein rengne jaisi anubhuti hoti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat appears black or darkened in color.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले का रंग काला पड़ गया है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale ka rang kala pad gaya hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat has a copper-colored or reddish-brown appearance.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले का रंग तांबे जैसा हो गया है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale ka rang tambe jaisa ho gaya hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat appears dark in color.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले का रंग गहरा पड़ गया है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale ka rang gehra pad gaya hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat has a blotchy, mottled, or uneven coloring.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जगह-जगह अलग-अलग रंग के धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jagah-jagah alag-alag rang ke dhabhe hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat appears pale or lighter in color than normal.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गला पीला पड़ गया है या रंग फीका लग रहा है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gala pila pad gaya hai ya rang fika lag raha hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat appears purple in color.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले का रंग बैंगनी हो गया है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale ka rang baingnee ho gaya hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The tonsils appear purple in color.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: टॉन्सिल का रंग बैंगनी हो गया है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Tonsil ka rang baingnee ho gaya hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat looks red or inflamed.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गला लाल हो गया है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gala lal ho gaya hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat looks a dark red color.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गला गहरा लाल हो गया है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gala gehra lal ho gaya hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat has red spots on it.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जगह-जगह लाल धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jagah-jagah lal dhabhe hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat shows a network or web-like pattern of redness.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले में लाल नसों का जाल दिखता है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale mein lal nason ka jaal dikhta hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The back of the throat (pharynx) looks red or inflamed.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से (ग्रसनी) में लालिमा है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale ke pichle hisse (graasni) mein lalima hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Throat, discoloration, redness, pharynx, back part
Skin/tissue changes.en: The very back part of the throat (pharynx) looks red or inflamed.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से की पिछली दीवार लाल हो गई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale ke pichle hisse ki pichli diwar lal ho gayi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The tonsils look red or inflamed.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: टॉन्सिल लाल हो गए हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Tonsil lal ho gaye hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The uvula (the small fleshy piece hanging at the back of the throat) looks red or inflamed.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले की अलिजिह्वा (कौआ) लाल हो गई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale ki alijihva (kauwa) lal ho gayi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat has white spots on it.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर सफेद धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par safed dhabhe hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is a white stripe or streak visible in the throat.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर सफेद धारी दिख रही है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par safed dhari dikh rahi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The throat has yellow spots on it.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर पीले धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par pile dhabhe hain.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry in the afternoon around 5 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद पाँच बजे गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad paanch baje gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry in the afternoon upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद नींद से जागने पर गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad nind se jagne par gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ke samay gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry in the evening around 6 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को छह बजे गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko chhah baje gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry in the evening before going to sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को सोने से पहले गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko sone se pehle gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry in the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय (दोपहर से पहले) गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay (dopahar se pehle) gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry around midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ko gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry after midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात के बाद गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ke baad gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry in the morning while waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह जागते समय गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah jagte samay gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry in the morning while walking around.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह चलते-फिरते समय गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah chlete-phirte samay gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के समय गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ke samay gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry at noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर के समय गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: dopahar ke samay gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels dry upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद से जागने पर गला सूखा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: neend se jagne par gala sukha rehta hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: The throat feels dry when outdoors in fresh air.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने पर गला सूखने लगता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Khuli hawa mein jane par gala sukhne lagta hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: The throat feels dry during a fever or feeling of heat.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: बुखार की गर्मी के दौरान गला सूखा रहता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Bukhar ki garmi ke dauran gala sukha rehta hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: The throat feels dry while lying in bed.
Linked to posture/position.hi: बिस्तर पर लेटे रहने पर गला सूखा रहता है।

Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sans andar lete samay gala sukha lagta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.roman: bistar se uthte samay gala sukha rehta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The throat feels so dry that speaking is very difficult.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बोलने में बहुत मुश्किल होती है क्योंकि गला सूखा रहता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: bolne mein bahut mushkil hoti hai kyunki gala sukha rehta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, dryness, walking in open air
Triggered by specific actions.en: The throat feels dry when walking outside in fresh air.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बाहर खुली हवा में चलने पर गला सूखा हो जाता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: bahar khuli hava mein chalne par gala sukha ho jata hai.

Type of pain.en: The dryness in the throat is painful.
Type of pain.hi: गले की सूखन में दर्द भी होता है।
Type of pain.roman: gale ki sukhan mein dard bhi hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, emptiness, on swallowing
Sensation / feel of the area.en: The throat feels empty when swallowing.

Sensation / feel of the area.roman: kuch nighlte samay gale mein khalipan mehsus hota hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There are small raw or worn-away spots in the throat.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले में कुछ जगहों पर छिलन या घाव जैसे धब्बे हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: gale mein kuch jagahon par chhilan ya ghav jaisa dhabbbe hain.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Food gets stuck or slows down in the swallowing tube (esophagus).

Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Bhojan nali mein khane se sambandhit koi taklif hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Throat, food, esophagus, food is felt until it enters the stomach
Linked to eating/digestion.en: Food can be felt all the way down the swallowing tube (esophagus) until it reaches the stomach.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: भोजन नली में खाना तब तक महसूस होता रहता है जब तक वह पेट में नहीं पहुँच जाता।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Bhojan nali mein khana tab tak mehsus hota raha jab tak vah pet mein nahin pahunch jata.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: When swallowing, food feels as if it is twisting or spiraling like a corkscrew down the swallowing tube (esophagus).
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: निगलते समय भोजन नली में खाना जैसे पेंच की तरह घूमता हुआ महसूस होता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Niglte samay bhojan nali mein khana jaise pench ki tarah ghumta hua mehsus hota hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Throat, food, esophagus, food, passed over raw places
Linked to eating/digestion.en: Food feels as if it is scraping over raw or sore patches as it travels down the swallowing tube (esophagus).
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: भोजन नली में खाना निगलते समय ऐसा लगता है जैसे वह किसी कच्चे या घाव वाली जगह से गुज़र रहा हो।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Bhojan nali mein khana niglte samay aisa lagta hai jaise vah kisi kachche ya ghav vali jagah se guzar raha ho.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Throat, food, esophagus, sensation as if food lodged in
Linked to eating/digestion.en: There is a sensation as if food is stuck somewhere in the swallowing tube (esophagus).
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: भोजन नली में खाना अटका हुआ महसूस होता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Bhojan nali mein khana atka hua mehsus hota hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Food or liquid feels as if it goes up into the back of the nose (nasal passages) instead of going down the throat.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: निगलते समय खाना गले के पीछे नाक की तरफ चला जाता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Niglte samay khana gale ke piche nak ki taraf chala jata hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, food, sensation of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation of food being present in the throat even when none is there.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में कुछ खाने जैसा अहसास होता है, जबकि कुछ खाया नहीं।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein kuch khane jaisa ahsas hota hai, jbki kuch khaya nahin.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, foreign body, sensation of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation of something stuck or foreign in the throat.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में कुछ अटका हुआ है जैसा महसूस होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein kuch atka hua hai jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, foreign body, sensation of, apple core

Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein andar koi dhili chamdi latakti hui mehsus hoti hai aur uske upar se bar-bar niglna padta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, foreign body, sensation of, stone
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation of a stone or hard lump stuck in the throat.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में कोई पत्थर जैसी चीज़ अटकी हुई महसूस होती है।

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, foreign body, sensation of, string, as if a

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, hair, sensation of

Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein khurdurpan hone ki wajah se khankharne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Inflammation.roman: Gale mein chhote-chhote danon jaisi sujan hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, afternoon
Linked to time of day.en: You have the sensation of a plug or lump stuck in your throat in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद गले में डाट जैसा कुछ फँसा हुआ लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad gale mein daat jaisa kuch fansa hua lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, evening
Linked to time of day.en: You have the sensation of a plug or lump stuck in your throat in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को गले में डाट जैसा कुछ फँसा हुआ लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko gale mein daat jaisa kuch fansa hua lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, forenoon
Linked to time of day.en: You have the sensation of a plug or lump stuck in your throat in the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर से पहले (सुबह के पहर में) गले में गुठली जैसा कुछ फँसा हुआ लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar se pehle (subah ke pehr mein) gale mein guthli jaisa kuch fansa hua lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, forenoon, riding, while
Linked to time of day.en: You have the sensation of a plug or lump stuck in your throat in the late morning while riding (in a vehicle or on horseback).
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के पहर में सवारी करते समय गले में गुठली जैसा अटकने का एहसास होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke pehr mein sawari karte samay gale mein guthli jaisa atkne ka ehsaas hota hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, morning
Linked to time of day.en: You have the sensation of a plug or lump stuck in your throat in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय गले में गुठली जैसा कुछ फँसा हुआ लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay gale mein guthli jaisa kuch fansa hua lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, night
Linked to time of day.en: You have the sensation of a plug or lump stuck in your throat at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को गले में गुठली जैसा कुछ फँसा हुआ लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko gale mein guthli jaisa kuch fansa hua lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, sleep, during
Linked to time of day.en: You feel as if there is a plug or lump stuck in your throat while you are asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद के दौरान गले में गुठली जैसा कुछ फँसा हुआ लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Neend ke dauran gale mein guthli jaisa kuch fansa hua lagta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, coughing amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: The feeling of a lump or plug in your throat gets better when you cough.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाँसने से गले में अटके गुठली जैसे एहसास में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khanste se gale mein atke guthli jaise ehsaas mein aaram milta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, eructations amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: The feeling of a lump or plug in your throat gets better when you burp.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: डकार आने पर गले में अटकी गुठली जैसे एहसास में आराम मिलता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Dakar aane par gale mein atki guthli jaise ehsaas mein aaram milta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, esophagus, swallowing amel.
Triggered by specific actions.en: The feeling of a plug or lump in your food pipe (esophagus) gets better when you swallow.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: निगलने पर भोजन की नली में अटका हुआ गुठली जैसा एहसास कम हो जाता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Nigalne par bhojan ki nali mein atka hua guthli jaisa ehsaas kam ho jata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, evening, swallowing, on
Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel a plug or lump in your throat in the evening when you swallow.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: शाम को निगलते समय गले में गुठली जैसा कुछ अटका हुआ लगता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Shaam ko nigalte samay gale mein guthli jaisa kuch atka hua lagta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, smoking, while
Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel as if there is a plug or lump stuck in your throat while smoking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बीड़ी/सिगरेट पीते समय गले में गुठली जैसा कुछ अटका हुआ लगता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Beedi/sigret pite samay gale mein guthli jaisa kuch atka hua lagta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, swallowing
Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel as if there is a lump or plug in your throat connected to swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: निगलते समय गले में गुठली जैसा कुछ फँसा हुआ लगता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Niglte samay gale mein guthli jaisa kuch fansa hua lagta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, swallowing, empty
Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel as if there is a lump or plug in your throat when you swallow saliva (dry swallowing).
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बिना कुछ खाए-पिए खाली निगलने पर गले में गुठली जैसा कुछ अटकने का एहसास होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Bina kuch khae-pie khali niglne par gale mein guthli jaisa kuch atakne ka ehsas hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, swallowing, not amel. by
Triggered by specific actions.en: Swallowing does not get rid of the feeling of a lump or plug in your throat.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: निगलने से भी गले में गुठली जैसे फँसे होने का एहसास ठीक नहीं होता।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Niglne se bhi gale mein guthli jaise fanse hone ka ehsas thik nahi hota.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, swallowing, on agg.
Triggered by specific actions.en: The feeling of a lump or plug in your throat gets worse when you swallow.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: निगलने पर गले में गुठली जैसे फँसे होने का एहसास और बढ़ जाता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Niglne par gale mein guthli jaise fanse hone ka ehsas aur badh jata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, swallowing, returns after
Triggered by specific actions.en: After you swallow, the feeling of a lump or plug in your throat comes back.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: निगलने के बाद फिर से गले में गुठली जैसा फँसने का एहसास लौट आता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Niglne ke baad phir se gale mein guthli jaisa fanse ka ehsas laut aata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, swallowing, when not
Triggered by specific actions.en: You feel the lump or plug in your throat most when you are NOT swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: जब नहीं निगलते तब गले में गुठली जैसा कुछ फँसा हुआ लगता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Jab nahi niglte tab gale mein guthli jaisa kuch fansa hua lagta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, esophagus, eating, after
Linked to eating/digestion.en: You feel as if there is a plug or lump stuck in your food pipe (esophagus) after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने के बाद भोजन की नली में कुछ अटका हुआ गुठली जैसा लगता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane ke baad bhojan ki nali mein kuch atka hua guthli jaisa lagta hai.

Type of pain.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, painful
Type of pain.en: The sensation of a lump or plug in your throat is painful.
Type of pain.hi: गले में जो गुठली जैसा अटकता है, उससे दर्द भी होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Gale mein jo guthli jaisa atakta hai, usse dard bhi hota hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Throat, lump, plug, etc., sensation of, swallowing, cold drinks, agg.
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: The feeling of a lump or plug in your throat gets worse when you drink cold drinks.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडा पानी पीने से गले में गुठली जैसे अटकने का एहसास और बढ़ जाता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thanda pani pine se gale mein guthli jaise atakne ka ehsas aur badh jata hai.

Specific body area.path: Throat, lump, sensation of a, left side
Specific body area.en: You feel as if there is a lump on the left side of your throat.
Specific body area.hi: गले के बाईं तरफ गुठली जैसा कुछ फँसा हुआ लगता है।
Specific body area.roman: Gale ke bayin taraf guthli jaisa kuch fansa hua lagta hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat has streaks of blood in it.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, उसमें खून की धारियाँ हैं।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, usmein khun ki dhariyan hain.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat looks bluish.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह नीली रंग की है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, vah nili rang ki hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat looks brownish.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह भूरे रंग की है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, vah bhure rang ki hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat has a white, curd-like appearance.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह दही जैसी दिखती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, vah dahi jaisi dikhti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat looks dark in colour.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह गहरे काले रंग की है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, vah gehre kale rang ki hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat is deeply embedded in the tissue.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जमी झिल्ली बहुत गहराई तक जमी हुई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jami jhilli bahut gehrai tak jami hui hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat looks dirty or unclean.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह गंदी/मैली दिखती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, wah gandi/maili dikhti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat looks dry and shrivelled.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह सूखी और सिकुड़ी हुई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, wah sukhi aur sikudi hui hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat is rubbery and can be stretched without tearing.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह लचीली है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, wah lachili hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane covers your entire throat.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: पूरे गले पर झिल्ली जमी हुई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Pure gale par jhilli jami hui hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat spreads up into your nose.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जमी झिल्ली नाक तक फैल रही है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jami jhilli nak tak fail rahi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat spreads down into your voice box (larynx).
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जमी झिल्ली श्वास नली (लैरिंक्स) तक फैल रही है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jami jhilli shwas nali (larynx) tak fail rahi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: There is a thick coating or film in your throat (such as seen with diphtheria).
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले में डिप्थीरिया जैसी झिल्ली या स्राव जमा हो गया है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale mein dipteria jaisi jhilli ya srav jama ho gaya hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat is located at the entrance to the throat (fauces — the area just behind the mouth).
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले के अंदर के खुले हिस्से (फॉसेज़) पर झिल्ली जमी हुई है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale ke andar ke khule hisse (fossae) par jhilli jami hui hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat looks gray.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह धूसर (ग्रे) रंग की है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, wah dhushar (grey) rang ki hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat looks greenish.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह हरी रंग की है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, wah hari rang ki hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat has an uneven or patchy appearance.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह ऊबड़-खाबड़ और असमान है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, wah ubad-khabar aur asman hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat looks thick and tough like leather.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह चमड़े जैसी मोटी और कड़ी है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, wah chamde jaisi moti aur kadi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat is on the left side.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले में झिल्ली बाईं तरफ जमी है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale mein jhilli bai taraf jami hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat switches from one side to the other.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले में झिल्ली कभी बाईं तरफ तो कभी दाईं तरफ बनती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale mein jhilli kabhi bai taraf to kabhi dai taraf banti hai.

Skin/tissue changes.path: Throat, membrane, left, extending to right
Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane starts on the left side of your throat and spreads to the right side.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले में झिल्ली बाईं तरफ से शुरू होकर दाईं तरफ फैल रही है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale mein jhilli bai taraf se shuru hokar dai taraf fail rahi hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat is not firmly attached and comes away easily.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर जो झिल्ली जमी है, वह ढीली है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jo jhilli jami hai, wah dhili hai.

Skin/tissue changes.en: The membrane in your throat moves or shifts from one area to another.
Skin/tissue changes.hi: गले पर झिल्ली एक जगह से दूसरी जगह खिसकती रहती है।
Skin/tissue changes.roman: Gale par jhilli ek jagah se dusri jagah khiskti rehti hai.

Discharge.en: There are patchy membranes (like a coating or film) forming in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में झिल्ली जैसे धब्बे बन गए हैं।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein jhilli jaise dhabbe ban gaye hain.

Discharge.en: There are isolated, separate patches of membrane forming in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में झिल्ली जैसे अलग-अलग धब्बे बने हैं।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein jhilli jaise alag-alag dhabbe bane hain.

Discharge.en: There are small specks or tiny patches of membrane forming in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में झिल्ली जैसे छोटे-छोटे धब्बे (बिंदु) बने हैं।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein jhilli jaise chhote-chhote dhabba (bindu) bane hain.

Discharge.en: There is a pearly-white membrane coating in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में मोती जैसी सफेद चमकदार झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein moti jaisi safed chamakdar jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.en: There is a membrane forming on the back wall of the throat (the pharynx).
Discharge.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से की दीवार पर झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Gale ke pichle hisse ki deewar par jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.en: There is a thick, widespread membrane covering a large area of the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में बहुत ज़्यादा झिल्ली बन गई है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein bahut zyada jhilli ban gayi hai.

Discharge.en: There is a foul-smelling, rotten membrane forming in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में बनी झिल्ली से बहुत बुरी बदबू आ रही है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein bani jhilli se bahut buri badbu aa rahi hai.

Discharge.en: There is a membrane forming on the right side of the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले के दाईं तरफ झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Gale ke dayin taraf jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.path: Throat, membrane, right, extending to left
Discharge.en: There is a membrane that starts on the right side of the throat and spreads to the left side.
Discharge.hi: गले के दाईं तरफ से झिल्ली बनकर बाईं तरफ भी फैल गई है।
Discharge.roman: Gale ke dayin taraf se jhilli bankar bayin taraf bhi fail gayi hai.

Discharge.en: There is only a small or thin amount of membrane forming in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में बहुत कम मात्रा में झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein bahut kam matra mein jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.en: There is a thick membrane coating forming in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में मोटी झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein moti jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.en: There is a thin membrane coating forming in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में पतली झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein patli jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.en: There is a membrane forming on the tonsils.
Discharge.hi: गले की टॉन्सिल पर झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Gale ki tonsil par jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.en: There is a membrane forming on the left tonsil.
Discharge.hi: बाईं टॉन्सिल पर झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Bayin tonsil par jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.en: There is a membrane forming on the right tonsil.
Discharge.hi: दाईं टॉन्सिल पर झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Dayin tonsil par jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.en: There is a see-through (transparent) membrane forming in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में पारदर्शी (आर-पार दिखने वाली) झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein paardarshi (aar-paar dikhne wali) jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.en: There is a membrane forming on the uvula (the small fleshy piece hanging at the back of the mouth).
Discharge.hi: गले के काँटे (uvula) पर झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Gale ke kaante (uvula) par jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.en: There is a shiny, varnish-like membrane coating in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में बनी झिल्ली वार्निश जैसी चमकदार दिखती है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein bani jhilli varnish jaisi chamakdar dikhti hai.

Discharge.en: There is a membrane in the throat that has a tough, chamois-leather-like appearance.
Discharge.hi: गले में बनी झिल्ली मुलायम चमड़े जैसी लगती है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein bani jhilli mulayam chamde jaisi lagti hai.

Discharge.en: There is a white membrane coating forming in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में सफेद रंग की झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein safed rang ki jhilli bani hai.

Discharge.en: There is a wrinkled or puckered membrane forming in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में बनी झिल्ली सिकुड़ी या झुर्रीदार दिखती है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein bani jhilli sikuri ya jhuridar dikhti hai.

Discharge.en: There is a yellow membrane coating forming in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में पीले रंग की झिल्ली बनी है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein pile rang ki jhilli bani hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Being out in the open air causes mucus to form or build up in the throat.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: खुली हवा में जाने पर गले में बलगम बढ़ जाता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Khuli hawa mein jane par gale mein balgam badh jata hai.

Discharge.en: There is thick, egg-white-like (albuminous) mucus in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में अंडे की सफेदी जैसा गाढ़ा बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein ande ki safedi jaisa gadha balgam jama rehta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat tastes bitter.
Discharge.hi: गले में कड़वा बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein kadwa balgam ata hai.

Discharge.en: There is bloody mucus in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में खून मिला हुआ बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein khun mila hua balgam ata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is hard to loosen or clear.
Discharge.hi: गले में बलगम चिपका रहता है और आसानी से नहीं निकलता।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein balgam chipka rehta hai aur asani se nahi nikalta.

Discharge.path: Throat, mucus, drawn from posterior nares
Discharge.en: Mucus drips down from the back of the nose into the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में नाक के पिछले हिस्से से बलगम उतरता रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein nak ke pichle hisse se balgam utarta rehta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat comes away and clears easily.
Discharge.hi: गले का बलगम आसानी से निकल जाता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale ka balgam asani se nikal jata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat looks or feels like a false membrane (a thick coating similar to a film).
Discharge.hi: गले में जमा बलगम झिल्ली जैसा लगता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein jama balgam jhilli jaisa lagta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat has a foul or bad smell.
Discharge.hi: गले में बदबूदार बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein badboodar balgam jama rehta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is frothy or bubbly.
Discharge.hi: गले में झागदार बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein jhagdar balgam ata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is jelly-like or gelatinous.
Discharge.hi: गले में जेली जैसा चिपचिपा बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein jelly jaisa chipchipa balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is sticky and glue-like.
Discharge.hi: गले में गोंद जैसा चिपचिपा बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein gond jaisa chipchipa balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is grayish in colour.
Discharge.hi: गले में धूसर (स्लेटी) रंग का बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein dhusar rang ka balgam aata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is greenish in colour.
Discharge.hi: गले में हरे रंग का बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein hare rang ka balgam aata hai.

Discharge.en: There is mucus hanging down at the back of the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में बलगम लटकता-सा लगता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein balgam latakta-sa lagta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat comes out in lumps or chunks.
Discharge.hi: गले में बलगम के गुठले (गाँठ जैसे टुकड़े) महसूस होते हैं।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein balgam ke guthle mehsus hote hain.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat leaves a metallic taste in the mouth.
Discharge.hi: गले में बलगम का स्वाद धातु जैसा (लोहे जैसा) लगता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein balgam ka swaad dhatu jaisa lagta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat has an offensive or unpleasant smell.
Discharge.hi: गले में बदबूदार (गंदी बास वाला) बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein badbudar balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.path: Throat, mucus, old cheese, tasting like
Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat tastes like old cheese.
Discharge.hi: गले में बलगम का स्वाद पुरानी सड़ी हुई पनीर जैसा लगता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein balgam ka swaad purani sadi hui paneer jaisa lagta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat smells or tastes putrid (rotten).
Discharge.hi: गले में बहुत बुरी गंध वाला सड़ा हुआ बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein bahut buri gandh wala sda hua balgam aata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is red like blood.
Discharge.hi: गले में खून जैसा लाल बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein khun jaisa lal balgam aata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat tastes salty.
Discharge.hi: गले में नमकीन स्वाद का बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein namkeen swaad ka balgam aata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat tastes sour.
Discharge.hi: गले में खट्टे स्वाद का बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein khatte swaad ka balgam aata hai.

Discharge.en: There is mucus in the throat that keeps needing to be swallowed.
Discharge.hi: गले का बलगम निगलना पड़ता है या थूकना पड़ता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale ka balgam nigalna padta hai ya thukna padta hai.

Discharge.path: Throat, mucus, swallow, which can neither swallow nor hawk up
Discharge.en: There is mucus stuck in the throat that can neither be swallowed down nor coughed or hawked up.
Discharge.hi: गले में बलगम ऐसा चिपका है जो न निगला जाता है और न थूका जाता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein balgam aisa chipka hai jo na nigla jata hai aur na thuka jata hai.

Discharge.en: There is mucus in the throat that has to be swallowed.
Discharge.hi: गले में बलगम आता है जिसे बार-बार निगलना पड़ता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein balgam aata hai jise bar-bar nigalna padta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat has a slightly sweet taste.
Discharge.hi: गले में मीठे स्वाद का बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein meethe swaad ka balgam aata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is sticky and hard to shift.
Discharge.hi: गले में बहुत चिपचिपा और लसदार बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein bahut chipchipa aur lasdar balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is sticky and hard to shift, and this is worse in the evening.
Discharge.hi: शाम को गले में बहुत चिपचिपा बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Discharge.roman: Shaam ko gale mein bahut chipchipa balgam jama ho jata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is sticky and hard to shift, and this is worse in the morning.
Discharge.hi: सुबह गले में बहुत चिपचिपा बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Subah gale mein bahut chipchipa balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is sticky and hard to shift, and this is worse at night.
Discharge.hi: रात को गले में बहुत चिपचिपा बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Discharge.roman: Raat ko gale mein bahut chipchipa balgam jama ho jata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is thick.
Discharge.hi: गले में गाढ़ा बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein gadha balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is thick, especially in the morning.
Discharge.hi: सुबह गले में गाढ़ा बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Subah gale mein gadha balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is thin and watery.
Discharge.hi: गले में पतला पानी जैसा बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein patla pani jaisa balgam aata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is thin and watery, especially in the morning.
Discharge.hi: सुबह गले में पतला पानी जैसा बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Subah gale mein patla pani jaisa balgam aata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is white.
Discharge.hi: गले में सफेद बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein safed balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is bright, milky white.
Discharge.hi: गले में दूध जैसा सफेद बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein doodh jaisa safed balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is white, especially in the morning.
Discharge.hi: सुबह गले में सफेद बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Subah gale mein safed balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is yellow.
Discharge.hi: गले में पीले रंग का बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein peele rang ka balgam aata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is yellow, especially in the late morning (forenoon).
Discharge.hi: दोपहर से पहले (सुबह के बाद वाले समय में) गले में पीला बलगम आता है।
Discharge.roman: Dopahar se pehle gale mein peela balgam aata hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is yellow and tends to be in the lower part of the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले के निचले हिस्से में पीला बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale ke neeche hisse mein peela balgam jama rahta hai.

Discharge.en: The mucus in the throat is yellow, especially in the morning.
Discharge.hi: सुबह गले में पीला बलगम जमा रहता है।
Discharge.roman: Subah gale mein peela balgam jama rahta hai.

Triggered by specific situations.en: Mucus collects in the throat while lying in bed.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: बिस्तर पर लेटे रहने पर गले में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Bistar par lete rehne par gale mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Mucus collects in the throat before breakfast.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: सुबह नाश्ते से पहले गले में बलगम जमा रहता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Subah nashte se pehle gale mein balgam jama rehta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Mucus collects in the throat while eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाते समय गले में बलगम आता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khate samay gale mein balgam ata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Mucus builds up in the throat in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को गले में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko gale mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Mucus builds up in the throat in the evening around 4 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को चार बजे गले में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko char baje gale mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Mucus builds up in the throat in the evening around 6 p.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को छह बजे गले में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko chah baje gale mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Mucus collects in the throat in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय गले में बलगम जमा रहता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay gale mein balgam jama rahta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Mucus collects in the throat in the morning around 11 a.m.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह ग्यारह बजे गले में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah gyarah baje gale mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is mucus in the throat first thing on waking in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद खुलने पर गले में बलगम जमा मिलता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind khulne par gale mein balgam jama milta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Mucus collects in the throat at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को गले में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko gale mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Mucus collects in the throat at midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: आधी रात को गले में बलगम जमा हो जाता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Aadhi raat ko gale mein balgam jama ho jata hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is mucus in the throat when waking during the night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को नींद खुलने पर गले में बलगम जमा मिलता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko nind khulne par gale mein balgam jama milta hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Mucus builds up in the throat during feelings of nausea or queasiness.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: जी मिचलाने के दौरान गले में बलगम आता है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Ji michlane ke dauran gale mein balgam aata hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, mucus, sensation of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a feeling or sensation of mucus being in the throat, even if none can be seen.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में बलगम होने का अहसास होता है (दिखता नहीं पर लगता है)।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein balgam hone ka ehsaas hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The throat feels narrow or tight when coughing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाँसते समय गला और तंग-सँकरा महसूस होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khaste samay gala aur tang-sankra mehsus hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The throat feels narrow or tight when swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: निगलते समय गला तंग या सँकरा महसूस होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Niglte samay gala tang ya sankra mehsus hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels blocked or obstructed in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय गले में कुछ अटका हुआ-सा लगता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay gale mein kuch atka hua-sa lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels blocked or obstructed on waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह नींद से जागने पर गले में कुछ अटका हुआ महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah nind se jagne par gale mein kuch atka hua mehsus hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The throat feels blocked or obstructed when swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: निगलते समय गले में कुछ अटका हुआ लगता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Niglte samay gale mein kuch atka hua lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is pain in the throat in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद गले में दर्द होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad gale mein dard hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a burning pain in the throat that occurs only during the daytime.
Linked to time of day.hi: दिन के समय गले में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Din ke samay gale mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a burning pain in the food pipe (esophagus) in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद खाने की नली में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad khane ki nali mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the swallowing tube (esophagus) that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय खाने की नली में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Sham ke samay khane ki nali mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the swallowing tube (esophagus) that occurs in the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के पहले पहर में (दोपहर से पहले) खाने की नली में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke pehle pehhr mein (dopahar se pehle) khane ki nali mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the swallowing tube (esophagus) that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह उठने पर खाने की नली में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah uthne par khane ki nali mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the swallowing tube (esophagus) that occurs at noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर के समय खाने की नली में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ke samay khane ki nali mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the throat that occurs in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को गले में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko gale mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the throat that occurs in the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के पहले पहर में (दोपहर से पहले) गले में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke pehle pehhr mein (dopahar se pehle) gale mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the throat that occurs in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय गले में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay gale mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the throat that occurs at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को गले में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko gale mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Throat, pain, burning, night, cold drinks, from
Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the throat at night that is triggered by cold drinks.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को ठंडा पानी पीने से गले में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko thanda pani pine se gale mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the throat that occurs around midnight.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात के बारह बजे के आसपास गले में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ke barah baje ke aaspass gale mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the throat that occurs at noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर को गले में जलन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ko gale mein jalan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the throat that gets better during sleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद लेने से गले की जलन कम हो जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Nind lene se gale ki jalan kam ho jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: A burning pain in the throat that is present upon waking.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद से जागने पर गले में जलन होती है।
