Gas & digestion.hi: डकार आते समय भोजन की नली में ऐंठन होती है।
Gas & digestion.roman: dakar ate samay bhojan ki nali mein aintan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The food pipe (esophagus) goes into spasms or cramps in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को भोजन की नली में ऐंठन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: shaam ko bhojan ki nali mein aintan hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The food pipe (esophagus) goes into spasms or cramps at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को भोजन की नली में ऐंठन होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: rat ko bhojan ki nali mein aintan hoti hai.

General.path: Throat, spasms, spasmodic constriction, convulsions etc.
General.en: The throat goes into severe spasms, tightening or convulsing.
General.hi: गले में ऐसी ऐंठन होती है कि दौरे जैसा लगता है और गला बंद हो जाता है।
General.roman: Gale mein aisi ainthan hoti hai ki daure jaisa lagta hai aur gala band ho jata hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Cold drinks bring on a feeling of suffocation or choking in the throat.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडा पानी पीने से गले में घुटन जैसा अहसास होता है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thanda pani pine se gale mein ghutan jaisa ahsaas hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: There is a feeling of suffocation or choking in the throat at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को गले में घुटन जैसा महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Rat ko gale mein ghutan jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Throat, suffocative sensation, warm drinks amel.
Linked to eating/digestion.en: Warm drinks make the suffocating or choking feeling in the throat better.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: गरम चीज़ें पीने से गले की घुटन कम हो जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Garam cheezein pine se gale ki ghutan kam ho jati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, sulphur vapor in throat, sensation of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a sensation of sulphur fumes or a burning chemical smell in the throat.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में गंधक की भाप जैसा अहसास होता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein gandak ki bhap jaisa ahsaas hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, sulphur vapor in throat, sensation of, inhalation
Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a sensation of sulphur fumes or a burning chemical smell in the throat when breathing in.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: सांस अंदर लेते समय गले में गंधक की भाप जैसा महसूस होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Sans andar lete samay gale mein gandak ki bhap jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, sulphur vapor in throat, sensation of, on coughing
Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a sensation of sulphur fumes or a burning chemical smell in the throat when coughing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: खाँसते समय गले में गंधक की भाप जैसा महसूस होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Khanste samay gale mein gandak ki bhap jaisa mehsus hota hai.

Inflammation.en: The tonsils are infected and producing pus.
Inflammation.hi: टॉन्सिल में पीप (मवाद) बन रही है।
Inflammation.roman: Tonsil mein peep ban rahi hai.

Inflammation.en: The left tonsil is infected and producing pus.
Inflammation.hi: बाईं तरफ के टॉन्सिल में पीप (मवाद) बन रही है।
Inflammation.roman: Bayin taraf ke tonsil mein peep ban rahi hai.

Inflammation.en: The right tonsil is infected and producing pus.
Inflammation.hi: दाईं तरफ के टॉन्सिल में पीप (मवाद) बन रही है।
Inflammation.roman: Dayin taraf ke tonsil mein peep ban rahi hai.

General.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing.
General.hi: बार-बार बार-बार निगलने की इच्छा होती रहती है।
General.roman: Bar-bar nigalne ki ichchha hoti rahti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, choking, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing because of a choking feeling.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गला घुटने (चोकिंग) जैसा लगने से बार-बार निगलना पड़ता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gala ghutne jaisa lagne se bar-bar nigalna padta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, contraction in larynx, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing because of a tightening feeling in the voice box area.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में सिकुड़न जैसी लगती है इसलिए बार-बार निगलना पड़ता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein sikudan jaisi lagti hai isliye bar-bar nigalna padta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, fullness, in throat, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing because the throat feels full.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गला भरा-भरा लगने से बार-बार निगलने की इच्छा होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gala bhara-bhara lagne se bar-bar nigalne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, lump in throat, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing because of a feeling of a lump in the throat.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में गोला (गाँठ) जैसा अहसास होने से बार-बार निगलना पड़ता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein gola jaisa ehsas hone se bar-bar nigalna padta hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, spasm in throat, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing because of a spasm or cramp in the throat.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले में ऐंठन की वजह से बार-बार निगलना पड़ता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale mein ainthan ki wajah se bar-bar nigalna padta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, eating amel.
Linked to eating/digestion.en: The constant urge to swallow gets better after eating.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना खाने से बार-बार निगलने की इच्छा कम हो जाती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana khane se bar-bar nigalne ki ichchha kam ho jati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Food is difficult to swallow.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: खाना निगलना मुश्किल लगता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Khana nigalna mushkil lagta hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, evening
Linked to time of day.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम के समय बार-बार निगलने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ke samay bar-bar nigalne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, night
Linked to time of day.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को बार-बार निगलने की इच्छा होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko bar-bar nigalne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to emotion/excitement.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, excitement agg.
Linked to emotion/excitement.en: Excitement makes the constant urge to swallow worse.
Linked to emotion/excitement.hi: उत्साहित या興奋होने पर बार-बार निगलने की इच्छा बढ़ जाती है।
Linked to emotion/excitement.roman: Utshahit ya utsaah hone par bar-bar nigalne ki ichchha badh jati hai.

Discharge.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, mucus, from thick
Discharge.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing because of thick mucus in the throat.
Discharge.hi: गले में गाढ़ा बलगम होने से बार-बार निगलना पड़ता है।
Discharge.roman: Gale mein gadha balgam hone se bar-bar nigalna padta hai.

Type of pain.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, pain in larynx, from
Type of pain.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing because of pain in the voice box area.
Type of pain.hi: गले में दर्द होने से बार-बार निगलना पड़ता है।
Type of pain.roman: Gale mein dard hone se bar-bar nigalna padta hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, speaking, while
Triggered by specific actions.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing while speaking.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: बोलते समय बार-बार निगलने की इच्छा होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Bolte samay bar-bar nigalne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.path: Throat, swallow, constant disposition to, walking in wind, while
Triggered by weather/temperature.en: There is a constant urge to keep swallowing while walking in the wind.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: हवा में चलते समय बार-बार निगलने की इच्छा होती है।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Hawa mein chalne ke samay bar-bar nigalne ki ichchha hoti hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Spicy or sharp-tasting foods are difficult to swallow.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: तीखी या खट्टी चीज़ें निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Tikhi ya khatti cheezen nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Swallowing is difficult at breakfast time.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: नाश्ते के समय निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Nashte ke samay nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Throat, swallowing, difficult, drink, must, in order to swallow
Linked to eating/digestion.en: Swallowing is difficult unless a drink of liquid is taken at the same time.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: निगलने के लिए साथ में पानी या कोई तरल पीना पड़ता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Nigalne ke liye sath mein pani ya koi taral pina padta hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Throat, swallowing, difficult, fluids only, can swallow, but solid food gags
Linked to eating/digestion.en: Liquids can be swallowed but solid food causes gagging.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: तरल चीज़ें तो निगल सकता/सकती हूँ लेकिन ठोस खाना निगलते ही उबकाई आती है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Taral cheezen to nigal sakta/sakti hoon lekin thos khana nigalte hi ubkai aati hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Liquids are difficult to swallow.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: तरल पदार्थ निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Taral padaarth nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.path: Throat, swallowing, difficult, liquids, more difficult than solids
Linked to eating/digestion.en: Liquids are harder to swallow than solid food.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: तरल चीज़ें निगलना ठोस चीज़ों से भी ज़्यादा मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Taral cheezen nigalna thos cheezon se bhi zyada mushkil hota hai.

Linked to eating/digestion.en: Solid food is difficult to swallow.
Linked to eating/digestion.hi: ठोस खाना निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to eating/digestion.roman: Thos khana nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: Swallowing is difficult because of uncontrolled muscle movements (chorea).
Comes with other symptoms.hi: नाच-कूद (नृत्य-विकार) की बीमारी के कारण निगलना मुश्किल हो गया है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Nach-kood ki beemari ke karan nigalna mushkil ho gaya hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Throat, swallowing, impossible, swelling of the tongue
Comes with other symptoms.en: Swallowing is completely impossible because the tongue is swollen.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: जीभ में सूजन के कारण निगलना बिल्कुल असंभव हो गया है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Jibh mein sujan ke karan nigalna bilkul asambhav ho gaya hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Swallowing is difficult in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Swallowing is difficult in the late morning (before noon).
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह दस-ग्यारह बजे के बीच निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah das-gyarah baje ke beech nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Swallowing is difficult in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Swallowing is difficult at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Raat ko nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Swallowing is difficult at noon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर के समय निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar ke samay nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Solid food is difficult to swallow in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के समय ठोस खाना निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke samay thos khana nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: It is hard to swallow when first waking up.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद से जागने पर निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Nind se jagane par nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Swallowing feels blocked or hindered during the night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को निगलने में रुकावट होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Rat ko nigalne mein rukavat hoti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: Swallowing happens while asleep.
Linked to time of day.hi: नींद में निगलने की क्रिया होती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Nind mein nigalne ki kriya hoti hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Swallowing is difficult during the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान निगलना मुश्किल हो जाता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Maahvari ke dauran nigalna mushkil ho jata hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Swallowing becomes completely impossible during the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी के दौरान कुछ भी निगलना बिल्कुल असंभव हो जाता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari ke dauran kuch bhi nigalna bilkul asambhav ho jata hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: Saliva is difficult to swallow.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: अपना थूक (लार) निगलना भी मुश्किल होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Apna thook nigalna bhi mushkil hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: It is hard to swallow sweet foods or drinks.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: मीठी चीज़ें निगलना मुश्किल होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Mithi cheezen nigalna mushkil hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.path: Throat, swallowing, impeded, pressure on larynx, from
Triggered by specific actions.en: Swallowing feels blocked or hindered when pressure is applied to the voice box area.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: गले पर दबाव पड़ने से निगलने में रुकावट होती है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Gale par dbaav padne se nigalne mein rukavat hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impeded
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Swallowing feels blocked or hindered.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: निगलने में रुकावट आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Nigalne mein rukavat aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impeded, liquids only
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Swallowing is blocked or hindered, but only with liquids.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: केवल तरल चीज़ें निगलने में रुकावट होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Keval taral cheezen nigalne mein rukavat hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impeded, liquids only, can swallow
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Liquids can be swallowed, but swallowing feels hindered.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: केवल तरल चीज़ें ही निगल पाता/पाती हूँ, बाकी में रुकावट है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Keval taral cheezen hi niglata/nigalti hun, baaki mein rukavat hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impeded, liquids only, can swallow, least food gags
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Liquids can go down, but even a tiny amount of food causes gagging.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: केवल तरल चीज़ें निगल पाता/पाती हूँ, थोड़ा सा भी खाना खाने पर उबकाई आती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Keval taral cheezen niglata/nigalti hun, thoda sa bhi khana khane par ubkai aati hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impeded, liquids only, can swallow, solids reach a certain point and are violently ejected
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Liquids can be swallowed, but solid food gets stuck at a certain point and is forcefully thrown back up.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: तरल चीज़ें ही निगल पाता/पाती हूँ; ठोस चीज़ें एक हद तक जाकर ज़ोर से बाहर निकल आती हैं।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Taral cheezen hi niglata/nigalti hun; thos cheezen ek had tak jakar zor se bahar nikal ati hain.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impeded, must drink at every mouthful to wash down the food
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Food feels so hard to get down that a sip of liquid is needed with every single mouthful to wash it down.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: हर निवाले के साथ कुछ घूँट पीना पड़ता है तब खाना नीचे जाता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Har niwale ke saath kuch ghunt pina padta hai tab khana niche jata hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impeded, solids
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Solid food is difficult or impossible to get past a certain point when swallowing.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: ठोस खाना निगलने में रुकावट होती है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Thos khana nigalne mein rukavat hoti hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impossible
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Swallowing is completely impossible.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: निगलना बिल्कुल संभव नहीं है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Nigalna bilkul sambhav nahi hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impossible, choking, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Swallowing is completely impossible because of choking.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गला घुटने (चोकिंग) के कारण निगलना बिल्कुल नहीं हो पाता।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gala ghutne (choking) ke karan nigalna bilkul nahi ho pata.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impossible, constriction of esophagus
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Swallowing is completely impossible because the food pipe feels tightly squeezed shut.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: खाने की नली सिकुड़ जाने के कारण कुछ भी निगलना संभव नहीं है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Khane ki nali sikud jane ke karan kuch bhi nigalna sambhav nahi hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impossible, liquids
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Liquids cannot be swallowed at all.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: तरल पदार्थ भी बिल्कुल निगल नहीं पाता/पाती हूँ।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Taral padarth bhi bilkul nigal nahi pata/pati hun.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impossible, liquids, anything but
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Everything except liquids cannot be swallowed.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: सिर्फ तरल के अलावा कुछ भी निगलना बिल्कुल असंभव है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Sirf taral ke alava kuch bhi nigalna bilkul asambhav hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impossible, liquids, even a teaspoonful of
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Even a teaspoonful of liquid cannot be swallowed.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: एक चम्मच तरल भी निगलना बिल्कुल संभव नहीं है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Ek chmach taral bhi nigalna bilkul sambhav nahi hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impossible, mucus is hawked out, until
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Swallowing is impossible until mucus has been coughed up and cleared from the throat.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: जब तक गले का बलगम बाहर नहीं निकालता/निकालती, तब तक निगलना बिल्कुल नहीं हो पाता।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Jab tak gale ka balgam bahar nahi nikalta/nikaalti, tab tak nigalna bilkul nahi ho pata.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, impossible, paralysis, from
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Swallowing is completely impossible because the throat muscles feel paralysed.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: गले की लकवा (पक्षाघात) के कारण निगलना बिल्कुल संभव नहीं है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Gale ki lakva (pakshaghaat) ke karan nigalna bilkul sambhav nahi hai.

Sensation / feel of the area.path: Throat, swallowing, incomplete
Sensation / feel of the area.en: Swallowing feels incomplete, as though food does not go all the way down.
Sensation / feel of the area.hi: निगलते समय खाना पूरी तरह नीचे नहीं जाता, अधूरा रह जाता है।
Sensation / feel of the area.roman: Nigalte samay khana puri tarah niche nahi jata, adhura reh jata hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Swallowing feels blocked or hindered while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटे रहने पर निगलने में रुकावट आती है।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Lete rahne par nigalne mein rukavat aati hai.

Linked to posture/position.en: Swallowing is completely impossible while lying down.
Linked to posture/position.hi: लेटने पर कुछ भी निगलना बिल्कुल नहीं हो पाता।
Linked to posture/position.roman: Letne par kuch bhi nigalna bilkul nahi ho pata.

Linked to a specific organ.en: Swallowing is completely impossible because the opening where the food pipe meets the stomach feels blocked.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: पेट में जहाँ खाना प्रवेश करता है (खाने की नली का निचला मुँह) वहाँ से निगलना बिल्कुल नहीं हो पाता।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Pet mein jaha khana praveesh karta hai (khane ki nali ka nicha munh) waha se nigalna bilkul nahi ho pata.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: Cold foods or drinks cannot be swallowed at all.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंडी चीज़ें बिल्कुल निगल नहीं पाता/पाती हूँ।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi cheezen bilkul nigal nahi pata/pati hun.

Triggered by specific situations.en: Swallowing is completely impossible during a severe fever illness (typhus).
Triggered by specific situations.hi: टाइफाइड बुखार के दौरान निगलना बिल्कुल संभव नहीं होता।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Typhaid bukhar ke dauran nigalna bilkul sambhav nahi hota.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Throat, swallowing, involuntary, walking in the wind, when
Triggered by specific situations.en: Swallowing happens involuntarily when walking in the wind.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: हवा में चलते समय अपने आप निगलने की क्रिया होती रहती है।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Hava mein chalte samay apne aap nigalne ki kriya hoti rahti hai.

General sensation.en: Swallowing happens on its own without meaning to.
General sensation.hi: बिना इरादे के अपने आप निगलने की क्रिया हो जाती है।
General sensation.roman: Bina irade ke apne aap nigalne ki kriya ho jati hai.

Swelling & bloating.en: The throat is swollen with a watery, puffy swelling.
Swelling & bloating.hi: गले में पानी भरने जैसी सूजन (सूजन नरम और फूली हुई) है।
Swelling & bloating.roman: Gale mein pani bharne jaisi sujan (sujan narm aur phuli hui) hai.

Swelling & bloating.hi: गले की टॉन्सिल्स (गिल्टियाँ) में सूजन है।
Swelling & bloating.roman: Gale ki tonsils (giltiyaan) mein sujan hai.

Swelling & bloating.hi: गले की बाईं तरफ की टॉन्सिल में सूजन है।
Swelling & bloating.roman: Gale ki bai taraf ki tonsil mein sujan hai.

Swelling & bloating.hi: गले की दाईं तरफ की टॉन्सिल में सूजन है।
Swelling & bloating.roman: Gale ki daii taraf ki tonsil mein sujan hai.

Swelling & bloating.en: The uvula (the little flap hanging at the back of the throat) is swollen.
Swelling & bloating.hi: गले की छोटी जीभ (कौवा) में सूजन है।
Swelling & bloating.roman: Gale ki chhoti jibh (kaura) mein sujan hai.

Swelling & bloating.en: The uvula (the little flap hanging at the back of the throat) has a watery, puffy swelling.
Swelling & bloating.hi: गले की छोटी जीभ (कौवा) में पानी भरने जैसी नरम सूजन है।
Swelling & bloating.roman: Gale ki chhoti jibh (kaura) mein pani bharne jaisi narm sujan hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat swelling is worse in the evening.
Linked to time of day.hi: शाम को गले में सूजन आ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Shaam ko gale mein sujan aa jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat swelling is worse in the morning.
Linked to time of day.hi: सुबह के वक्त गले में सूजन रहती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Subah ke waqt gale mein sujan rahti hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat swelling is worse at night.
Linked to time of day.hi: रात को गले में सूजन आ जाती है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Rat ko gale mein sujan aa jati hai.

Linked to time of day.en: The throat feels tight or tense in the afternoon.
Linked to time of day.hi: दोपहर बाद गले में खिंचाव या तनाव महसूस होता है।
Linked to time of day.roman: Dopahar baad gale mein khinchaav ya tanav mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to a specific organ.en: The food pipe (esophagus) feels tight or tense.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: भोजन की नली (खाना निगलने वाली नली) में खिंचाव या तनाव महसूस होता है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Bhojan ki nali (khana nigalne wali nali) mein khinchaav ya tanav mehsoos hota hai.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: The throat feels tight or tense before the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी (मासिक धर्म) आने से पहले गले में खिंचाव महसूस होता है।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari (masik dharm) aane se pehle gale mein khinchaav mehsoos hota hai.

Specific body area.en: The right side of the throat feels tight or tense.
Specific body area.hi: गले की दाईं तरफ खिंचाव या तनाव महसूस होता है।
Specific body area.roman: Gale ki dain taraf khinchaav ya tanav mehsoos hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The throat feels tight or tense when swallowing.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: निगलते वक्त गले में खिंचाव महसूस होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Nigelte waqt gale mein khinchaav mehsoos hota hai.

Triggered by specific actions.en: The throat feels tight or tense when yawning.
Triggered by specific actions.hi: जम्हाई लेते समय गले में खिंचाव महसूस होता है।
Triggered by specific actions.roman: Jamhai lete samay gale mein khinchaav mehsoos hota hai.

Comes with other symptoms.en: A tickling feeling in the throat that sets off a cough.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: गले में गुदगुदी होती है जिससे खाँसी आ जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Gale mein gudgudi hoti hai jisse khansi aa jati hai.

Linked to a specific organ.en: There is a tingling feeling in the food pipe (esophagus).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: भोजन की नली (खाना निगलने वाली नली) में झनझनाहट या सिहरन महसूस होती है।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Bhojan ki nali (khana nigalne wali nali) mein jhanjhanhat ya sihran mehsoos hoti hai.

Comes with other symptoms.path: Throat, twitching, extending to pit of stomach
Comes with other symptoms.en: The throat twitches and the twitching feeling runs down to the pit of the stomach.
Comes with other symptoms.hi: गले में फड़कन होती है जो पेट के ऊपरी बीच वाले हिस्से तक जाती है।
Comes with other symptoms.roman: Gale mein fadkan hoti hai jo pet ke uparli beech wale hisse tak jati hai.

Type of pain.en: The ulcers in the throat burn.
Type of pain.hi: गले में जलन करने वाले छाले या घाव हैं।
Type of pain.roman: Gale mein jalan karne wale chhale ya ghav hain.

Type of pain.en: The ulcers in the throat have a stinging pain.
Type of pain.hi: गले के घावों में चुभन या डंक जैसा दर्द होता है।
Type of pain.roman: Gale ke ghavon mein chubhan ya dank jaisa dard hota hai.

Triggered by weather/temperature.en: The throat ulcers get worse from cold.
Triggered by weather/temperature.hi: ठंड लगने पर गले के घाव बढ़ जाते हैं।
Triggered by weather/temperature.roman: Thandi lagane par gale ke ghav badh jate hain.

Inflammation.en: The ulcers in the throat are deep.
Inflammation.hi: गले में गहरे छाले या घाव हैं।
Inflammation.roman: Gale mein gehre chhale ya ghav hain.

Inflammation.en: The ulcers in the throat have an unpleasant smell or taste.
Inflammation.hi: गले के घावों से बदबू आती है।
Inflammation.roman: Gale ke ghavon se badbu aati hai.

Inflammation.en: The throat ulcers are spreading and getting larger.
Inflammation.hi: गले के छाले या घाव फैलते जा रहे हैं।
Inflammation.roman: Gale ke chhale ya ghav failte ja rahe hain.

Linked to a specific organ.en: There are ulcers (open sores) in the food pipe (esophagus).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: भोजन की नली (खाना निगलने वाली नली) में छाले या घाव हैं।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Bhojan ki nali (khana nigalne wali nali) mein chhale ya ghav hain.

Linked to a specific organ.en: There are ulcers (open sores) in the back of the throat (pharynx).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से (ग्रसनी) में छाले या घाव हैं।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ke pichle hisse (grasni) mein chhale ya ghav hain.

Linked to a specific organ.en: There are ulcers (open sores) on the tonsils.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: टॉन्सिल्स (गिल्टियों) पर छाले या घाव हैं।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Tonsils (giltiyun) par chhale ya ghav hain.

Linked to a specific organ.en: There are yellow ulcers (open sores) on the tonsils.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: टॉन्सिल्स पर पीले रंग के छाले या घाव हैं।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Tonsils par pile rang ke chhale ya ghav hain.

Specific body area.en: There are ulcers (open sores) at the back of the throat where it opens wide (the fauces).
Specific body area.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से (मुँह के अंदर गहराई में) में छाले या घाव हैं।
Specific body area.roman: Gale ke pichle hisse (munh ke andar gehrai mein) mein chhale ya ghav hain.

Specific body area.en: There are burning ulcers (open sores) at the back of the throat where it opens wide (the fauces).
Specific body area.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से में छाले हैं जिनमें जलन भी है।
Specific body area.roman: Gale ke pichle hisse mein chhale hain jinmein jalan bhi hai.

Specific body area.en: There are ulcers (open sores) on the left side of the throat.
Specific body area.hi: गले की बाईं तरफ छाले या घाव हैं।
Specific body area.roman: Gale ki bayin taraf chhale ya ghav hain.

Specific body area.en: There are ulcers (open sores) on the right side of the throat.
Specific body area.hi: गले की दाईं तरफ छाले या घाव हैं।
Specific body area.roman: Gale ki dayin taraf chhale ya ghav hain.

Specific body area.en: There are ulcers (open sores) on the uvula (the little flap hanging at the back of the throat).
Specific body area.hi: गले की छोटी जीभ (कौवे) पर छाले या घाव हैं।
Specific body area.roman: Gale ki chhoti jibh (kawe) par chhale ya ghav hain.

Specific body area.en: There are ulcers on the uvula (the little flap hanging at the back of the throat) that are spreading and getting larger.
Specific body area.hi: गले की छोटी जीभ (कौवे) पर घाव हैं जो फैलते जा रहे हैं।
Specific body area.roman: Gale ki chhoti jibh (kawe) par ghav hain jo failte ja rahe hain.

Specific body area.en: There are syphilis-related ulcers on the uvula (the little flap hanging at the back of the throat).
Specific body area.hi: गले की छोटी जीभ (कौवे) पर सिफलिस (एक खास संक्रमण) से जुड़े घाव हैं।
Specific body area.roman: Gale ki chhoti jibh (kawe) par syphilis (ek khas sankraman) se jude ghav hain.

Linked to menstrual cycle.en: Throat ulcers appear or get worse just before the menstrual period.
Linked to menstrual cycle.hi: माहवारी (मासिक धर्म) आने से पहले गले में छाले या घाव निकलते हैं।
Linked to menstrual cycle.roman: Mahwari (masik dharm) aane se pehle gale mein chhale ya ghav nikhlte hain.

Triggered by specific situations.en: Throat ulcers that developed after taking mercury (a mercury-based treatment).
Triggered by specific situations.hi: पारे (मर्करी) की दवाई लेने के बाद गले में छाले या घाव हो गए हैं।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Pare (mercury) ki dawai lene ke baad gale mein chhale ya ghav ho gaye hain.

Triggered by specific situations.path: Throat, ulcers, scarlet fever does not come out, when
Triggered by specific situations.en: Throat ulcers that appear when the scarlet fever rash fails to come out on the skin.
Triggered by specific situations.hi: जब स्कार्लेट बुखार का दाना ठीक से नहीं निकला हो, तब गले में घाव हो जाते हैं।
Triggered by specific situations.roman: Jab Scarlet bukhar ka dana theek se nahi nikla ho, tab gale mein ghav ho jate hain.

Linked to a specific organ.en: There are varicose (swollen, twisted) veins in the back of the throat (pharynx).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से (ग्रसनी) में नसें फूली हुई हैं।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ke pichle hisse (grasni) mein nasein phuli hui hain.

Linked to a specific organ.en: There are varicose (swollen, twisted) veins on the tonsils.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: टॉन्सिल्स (गिल्टियों) की नसें फूली हुई हैं।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Tonsils (giltiyom) ki nasein phuli hui hain.

Linked to a specific organ.en: There are small blisters (vesicles) in the back of the throat (pharynx).
Linked to a specific organ.hi: गले के पिछले हिस्से (ग्रसनी) में छोटे-छोटे दाने या फफोले हैं।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Gale ke pichle hisse (grasni) mein chhote-chhote dane ya phaple hain.

Linked to a specific organ.en: There are small blisters (vesicles) on the tonsils.
Linked to a specific organ.hi: टॉन्सिल्स (गिल्टियों) पर छोटे-छोटे दाने या फफोले हैं।
Linked to a specific organ.roman: Tonsils (giltiyom) par chhote-chhote dane ya phaple hain.
